blurb: A placeholder that appears in the reference locale's template and in another locale's must be formatted the same way in both: plain `{n}`, `plural`, `select`, `number` or `date`. The caller supplies one kind of value for it, and an interface cannot sensibly be plural-aware in one language and plain in another. Use the same kind in every locale. The arms inside a `plural` or `select` may differ. A different placeholder name is `bynk.messages.placeholder_mismatch`.
summary: A code's placeholder is formatted as a different ICU kind (plain/plural/select/number/date) across declared locales.
